structured.approach: I read feat.tasks to find the two Data Science tasks for ap_forecast (TSK-03 and TSK-04). org.permission_table is restricted, so I used it only through the tool:repo-access view, which says ap_forecast requires and is granted no secrets. To check that view against the code, I searched the ap_forecast source and tests for secret, token, key, credential and environment-variable use. I then read explain.py, predict.py and models.json to see whether either task makes an external call. Neither does: explain.py only builds a request dict and never sends it. I wrote task.secrets_scope with names only and no values, giving the required and granted scope for each environment. Both are empty, so no access request was needed. I did not use any connector because none was needed.

claims.text: The Data Science lane's tasks for FEAT-ZD-48600 are TSK-03 (STORY-03) and TSK-04 (STORY-04), both in ap_forecast.
The permission table's tool registry says no secrets are required or granted for the ap_forecast repository.
TSK-03 vendor_risk is rule-based, with no LLM, no network and no models.json read, and it uses only predict_delay_days, which relies on the standard-library statistics module.

build_explanation_request only builds and returns a request dict with provider, model, max_tokens and messages taken from models.json or the passed config. It does not send the request, so TSK-04 needs no provider credential.
No API key, token, password, credential or environment-variable use was found in the ap_forecast source or tests. The only match was the max_tokens request parameter.
Sending the risk label to acme-llm waits on Architect confirmation (TQ-8), which gates release, not coding.
The required and granted secrets are both empty for local/CI, dev and main, so no access request was raised.

open_questions: SSQ-1 (non-blocking): Which component sends the build_explanation_request payload to acme-llm, and who owns its credential? It is outside ap_forecast and outside the scope of TSK-03 and TSK-04. If ap_forecast ever calls the provider directly, DS-02 must be re-entered.
structured.summary: DS-02 is complete. The ap_forecast tasks (TSK-03 and TSK-04) need no secrets in any environment, and the permission table grants none, so required and granted access match and both are empty. No access request was needed. I wrote task.secrets_scope.md with names only and one non-blocking question (SSQ-1) about who owns the acme-llm credential outside ap_forecast.
